d: In this video, we look at the future of the global Hindu population, based on a major report released by the Pew Research Center on November 18, 2026. According to the projections, the Hindu population in Pakistan could double to nearly 10 million by 2070, while the United States could see its Hindu population rise from 3 million to 7.4 million, largely driven by immigration. The report also examines how India's Hindu population will evolve, why Hindus are expected to remain more than three-quarters of India's population, and how demographic changes could reshape the religious composition…
